_comment: Tier-2 for dune::linear_elasticity#2 and _general.natural_bc_measured.Signal_pointwise_indicator. The elasticity form is character-for-character the one in componentwise_bc_corner_drops_a_constraint so the compiled module is shared; wall time 114 s on 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2), of which one build is the extra-BC variant. Measured on a 4x4 dimRange=2 grid with u_x=0 on x=0 and u_y=0 on y=0: the corner dof reads 1.909986e-06, 0.0. Adding DirichletBC(space,[0,0], And(x[0]<tol, x[1]<tol)) to pin that node was ACCEPTED and changed the solution by EXACTLY 0.0 — the corner value is unchanged to every printed digit. Two controls make that null result mean something: an EDGE-sized BC (u_y=0 on the top edge, an edge the base does not already constrain in that component) moved the solution by 2.010541e-06, and walking the 16 boundary facets found ZERO whose centre satisfies both coordinate tests — which is the geometric reason. Note an edge-sized BC on an edge the base ALREADY constrains changes nothing either, because component-wise masks on the same edge merge; that is why the control uses a different edge.
